 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Connect the 1 to the 2 with a diagonal segment followed by a straight
    # segment in the direction of the remaining displacement.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    p1 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    p2 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r, c = p1
    dr, dc = p2[0] - r, p2[1] - c
    sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1 if dr < 0 else 0
    sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1 if dc < 0 else 0
    # Draw the diagonal until one step before the endpoint's row/column is met,
    # then continue straight along the other axis.
    n = min(abs(dr), abs(dc))
    if abs(dr) <= abs(dc) and abs(dr):
        n = max(0, n - 1)
    elif abs(dc) <= abs(dr) and abs(dc):
        n = max(0, n - 1)
    for _ in range(n):
        r += sr; c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    # Continue on the axis that still separates the endpoint from this point.
    if abs(dr) > abs(dc):
        while r + sr != p2[0]:
            r += sr; out[r][c] = 3
    elif abs(dc) > abs(dr):
        while c + sc != p2[1]:
            c += sc; out[r][c] = 3
    return out
